scope: Read-only independent review; no EA/new MT5 runs/additional bootstrap
notes: Independent level reconstruction: confirmed pivot rows strictly preceding ORDER and source before W1 origin; remove only when later known upper closes cross half point; all 475 features matched.
Boundaries are [0.25,0.5), [0.5,1), >=1; observed minimum validates first label.
NO_OBSERVED_BLOCK / NEAR are registry observations, not absence proofs or human resistance truth.
available_external_pivots counts all prior same-side candidates beyond entry, including candidates inside W1; does not count only outside-W1 levels.
A uses M15 close retirement; B uses M5 close retirement; different feature construction across arms is explicitly stated.
The middle room bucket is a descriptive post-hoc weak subgroup, not a positive-expectancy rule or causal filter result.
